[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34055295/ccaaa3315111ff78e0697412c5deaaa6ed75e54d.png[/img]

This is a tale from when Producer K was still a high-school student.

One day, Producer K had to stay late at school to take extra lessons to help him study. After his lessons had finished, he left the school in a rush. Worried that he wouldn’t make it home in time to see his favorite anime, Producer K decided to take a shortcut home. The road he decided to take was under construction, with long weeds everywhere obstructing his vision. Moreover, with no street lights to help light the way, the road was very dark. At times like this, Producer K would usually rethink things and take the long way home, but today, he wanted to watch the last episode of his favorite anime no matter what the cost. Looking back on it, he should have simply recorded it and listened to his better judgment...

Using the flashlight on his phone to light the way and navigate the weeds, Producer K noticed a small light swaying a little bit in front of him. At first, he thought it was just another person using the flashlight on their phone. After all, it wouldn’t be that rare to pass by another person on the path. Thinking nothing of it, he continued down the path. Yet as he got closer, he realized it wasn’t a light...but a lone woman. Despite the cold weather, she was wearing a pure-white yukata, and was faintly glowing for some reason.

Immediately sensing trouble, Producer K tried to go back the way he came. Yet as soon as the woman saw him, she started racing toward him at an incredible speed. Wearing a crazed expression, she quickly closed the distance, grabbed him, and...

Hey, hey, hey! I think that’s enough of my past for now. We’ve got to do the event preview! As I’m sure you know by now, our event this time is filled with horror and suspense, so turn off the lights, snuggle up under your covers and get ready for a frighteningly good time! You can even get a special photo if you finish reading both endings, so don’t miss this chance!

Huh? How does the story end, you ask? Let’s just say my prank of switching my mom’s shampoo for fluorescent paint didn’t end well...

notes.title: Notice from Producer K
notes.notes:
Hey, ninjas! Producer K in the house with some helpful information regarding our Cookie Collection Chronicles events!

1. First of all, you can access these events by clicking on our ongoing events banner. You can also access them by clicking on Menu and then the Chronicles button.
2. Regarding the time period for a Cookie Collection Chronicles event, 1 event lasts for 7 days. However, you can continue with the same score as long as you don’t pick a different Chronicles event the next time you play.
3. We will not be implementing boosts during our Chronicles events. Furthermore, you will not receive double Cookies even if you play a Chronicles event during a regular Cookie Collection event boost.
4. There are no ranking rewards in Cookie Collection Chronicles events. In exchange, past ranking awards are now rewarded when you reach a certain amount of total Cookies.
5. Cookie Collection Chronicles events require special tickets. We are planning on giving these out in a variety of ways, such as for event rewards and special occasions, so be on the lookout for them!

As I have touched upon before, the scores are a little high for some of the items given out as event rewards in the past. This is in consideration for the players who spent lots of resources and time in the past to get them. Please also note that we are prioritizing the release of older past Cookie Collection events (events 6 months or older). Whether you enjoyed these events when they first came out, or are just now getting the chance to enjoy them, we hope you have fun with our blast to the past! However, please understand that we will not reveal when which events are going to be released.

If you have any questions about these Cookie Collection Chronicles events, you can find a ton of information by pushing the ? button, which is located at the bottom left of our Cookie Collection Chronicles event page.

Well, that’s all for me today! See you awesome people later!

notes.title: Notice from Producer K
notes.notes:
Hey, guys! 

Producer K here with another update for you guys. To tell you the truth, it pains me to have to write this down, because I thought it would be understood when we released the event. Nevertheless, I feel like it is necessary to clear the air on some things.

As everyone already knows, we released our My Little Sister Gacha today. While it is true that we have our girls acting like our MC’s little sisters, please don’t misunderstand us. There is no way we would ever make anything remotely close to incest. Not only does that go against our philosophy and moral standards here at NTT Solmare, but it would also cause our game to be deleted completely off the store. 

We try to come up with new and exciting ideas every day here at Solmare. The scenario this time (as with pretty much all of our side scenarios) is a what-if scenario. That what-if scenario being that the girls are the MC’s little sister. That doesn’t mean that people like Tengge and Lily (who are indeed older than the MC) will magically go back in time and become younger. We just wanted to provide a scenario where everyone could experience the powerful bonds of family love and care. 

We apologize if there was any misunderstanding, but we ask you to enjoy the scenario like we intended, a nice brother-sister scenario where we can enjoy a softer side to things. We would never make a scenario that made everyone disgusted or sad, so please keep that in mind in the future. There are a lot of rules we have to follow when we release scenarios. Not only do we follow those rules, but we also follow our own strict moral guidelines. 

So, I ask you to remember this when you read our story this time. It’s true our game is a harem game and we put the MC in silly, perverted scenarios sometimes, but we would never joke about something like this.

Thank you for your understanding and we hope you will enjoy our story this time!

-Producer K
